signed_authority_assessment.production_trust_root: BLOCKED: option_env! accepts the verifying key from the compiler environment. The frozen source and runtime digest do not name the owner key fingerprint, and the packet/executable signature is verified by the same substitutable embedded key. A rebuild can therefore substitute a new verifying key, executable digest and matching signatures unless an independent trusted channel pins the owner key or exact executable.

predecessor_finding_dispositions.evidence: Repository root and decision names are no longer envelope inputs; strict owner signatures reject edited status. However the owner verifying key is supplied by the build environment and is not independently pinned by the frozen source, an accepted key fingerprint, trusted launcher or reproducible-build attestation.
The signed-authority repair does not add an on-chain proof that the committed HPKE envelope decrypts. Exact trial preflight and post-retrieval opening remain the evidence boundary.
Recipient observations still expose the deterministic plaintext commitment as output_sha256 in terminal evidence.
The external fsync JSONL journal remains unhashed, unauthenticated and unbound to packet/trial identity; reconciliation checks signature finality but does not reconstruct accounts or storage state.

RecipientKeyDirectory registration remains overwriteable and prepare/open still do not independently derive and validate every binding/fingerprint, though the exact executor constructs consistent bindings and pre-opens A, B and B2.

The envelope still supplies calculated_test_sol_lamports; protocol-account rents are not individually calculated or itemized. The new deployment preflight contradiction is separately elevated to IR4-H01.
Zeroizing covers selected byte buffers, but file permissions, encrypted-at-rest custody, process memory locking and Solana Keypair zeroization remain external host responsibilities.
The exact Cargo.lock now also pins ed25519-dalek 2.2.0, but no current advisory scan, deny policy, SBOM/provenance attestation or license assessment is joined.

The signed-authority unit test adds useful rejection coverage, but deployment, journal ordering, ambiguous RPC/finality, reconciliation, evidence closure and cross-layer failure branches still lack deterministic mock/fault-injection tests.
Lean, TLC and Alloy remain bounded abstract-model evidence and do not prove the Rust/SQL/Solana/authority implementation refines those models.

unresolved_findings.title: The terminal gate rejects the exact frozen SBF before authority evaluation
unresolved_findings.evidence: For the exact 98,016-byte SBF, conservative_sbf_submissions computes ceil(98,016/512)+2 = 194. validate_envelope permits at most 192 deployment submissions. An independent exact-SBF packet probe returned DeploymentBudgetImpossible. The loader implementation would use 128 writes plus create and finalize, exactly 130, but that exact count is not used by the terminal preflight.
unresolved_findings.impact: No packet containing the exact frozen SBF can reach signature validation or Devnet execution under the compiled policy, so the claimed terminal path is internally impossible.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Make the preflight and loader use one exact, reviewed deployment-count contract or raise the separately owner-authorized cap above the conservative bound; then re-freeze source, executable identity, tests, binding and review.

unresolved_findings.title: A build can substitute the owner verifying key and construct a self-consistent authority set
unresolved_findings.evidence: OWNER_VERIFYING_KEY_HEX is option_env!(CA2_OWNER_DECISION_VERIFYING_KEY_HEX). The frozen source/runtime digest does not bind a specific owner key fingerprint. The decision wrappers compare their fingerprint to the embedded key, and the authorization signs the packet and executable digest, but both signatures are verified by that same build-selected key. The no-key build correctly fails closed; this does not prevent a non-owner rebuild with a different valid key.
unresolved_findings.impact: Without an independently trusted key or executable anchor, a caller controlling the build can compile another key, sign accepted/authorized payloads with its matching private key and obtain the same technical authority result in an alternate fixed-root build. The former envelope-path issue is removed, but owner provenance remains self-assertable at build time.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Pin the owner verifying-key fingerprint in an independently accepted immutable predecessor, trusted launcher/OS policy, or reproducible-build attestation whose trust does not derive from the candidate executable. Bind the exact key-bearing executable through that independent channel and test key-substitution rejection.

unresolved_findings.title: On-chain tuple commitment does not prove HPKE decryptability
unresolved_findings.evidence: The program binds requested key and envelope commitments, while the executor opens B2 before and after effects; the Solana program cannot verify the HPKE relation.
unresolved_findings.required_disposition: Keep the claim trial-evidence-bounded or add recipient acknowledgment/proof before treating public fulfilled state alone as usable fulfillment.
